description.value: Despite the speed with which you apply them, your modifications are stable and long-lasting. Whenever you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Modify] an item, it remains modded for 1 minute rather than until the end of your next turn. The first time the modded item would gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Glitching] condition, reduce the value of the glitching condition by 1.
